description: Report that something in the CrowdSpace catalogue is wrong or out of date — a minimum investment that no longer matches the platform, a regulator that changed, a dead website. Use it when a reader points out an error, or when you can see the catalogue disagrees with a source you have. It does NOT change the site: the report goes to a queue a person reviews, and the tool result says so — do not tell the user the data has been corrected. Say what is wrong in a sentence, and include the URL you saw it on when you have one; a report nobody can check is one nobody can act on.

evidence_url.description: Where you saw the correct value — the platform's own page, a regulator register.

field.description: Which field is wrong. Use `other` only when none of the rest fits.

platform.description: The platform's slug — the last segment of the profile URL that search_platforms returns, e.g. `mintos`.

problem.description: What is wrong with it, in a sentence.

suggested_value.description: What it should say, if you know.

name: report_inaccuracy

outputSchema.description: Acknowledgement of a filed report. Nothing on the site changed.

status.description: Always `new` here — a person moves it from there.

title: Report an inaccuracy
